app.name: VI PLL probe (writes clock regs)
app.short_description: Writes VI PLL candidates, measures the real clock, logs to USB
app.long_description: EXPERIMENTAL. Writes to the undocumented Hollywood VI clock/PLL registers (0x1C4/0x1C8 and the 0x1A0 group), measures the resulting VI pixel clock against the CPU timebase, and logs before/after values to vi_pll.txt on the USB drive (and SD if present). Each experiment holds briefly, then restores the original register values; all clock registers also reset on console power cycle. The display will lose sync during the run. Press A (or wait 10 s) to start; HOME/Start exits. Returns to the Homebrew Channel when done.
